description: This Java class implements a listener for changes to a specific global property related to Person Name formatting in the OpenMRS system. It reacts when the global property for name layout changes and updates the PersonName format accordingly.

classes.name: PersonNameGlobalPropertyListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling changes to the Person Name format global property.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the given property name matches the specific property for name layout format.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the PersonName format when the relevant global property value changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handler for when the global property is deleted; currently does nothing.
